name: pixel-asset-forge
description: Generate commercial-grade pixel-art game assets from a description: character sheets, four-direction animations (idle/walk/attack/hurt/death), props, weapons, FX and tiles. Handles chroma-key background removal, connected-component frame extraction, pixel-grid snapping, cross-action scale profiling, bottom-center anchoring, palette quantization, quality validation and engine export (Godot SpriteFrames / generic JSON). Use for: make a pixel character, generate a walk animation, produce a sprite sheet, export to Godot, fix a broken asset. Requires the user's own OpenAI-compatible API key.
